title: Present middle/passive
subtitle: Read the shared present middle/passive endings.
overview: Present middle and passive forms share endings; context tells whether the action is self-involving, reciprocal, passive, or lexically middle.
Do not force the English word “self” into every middle form.

sections.title: λύομαι: present middle/passive
rows: I am being loosed / I loose myself
he, she, it is being loosed
we / you all / they are being loosed
